notice_hugo_path_not_set: Please configure the Hugo path in the plugin settings first
notice_invalid_hugo_path: The Hugo path must be an absolute path
notice_invalid_content_path: The content path must stay inside the Hugo project
notice_sync_success: {fileName} exported to {directoryName}; cleaned metadata from {cleanedCount} images
notice_export_fail: Export failed, please check the developer console for details.
notice_invalid_export_name: Cannot use “{fileName}” as the export directory name
notice_export_in_progress: An export is already being reviewed
notice_open_settings_manually: Open Settings → Hugo Exporter to configure AI review
setting_hugo_path_desc: The absolute path to your Hugo project
setting_content_path_desc: A relative path inside your Hugo project
setting_content_path_invalid: Enter a relative path that stays inside the Hugo project
setting_replacements_desc: Replace body text, titles, and string frontmatter values in order during export
setting_ai_enabled_desc: Review the final Markdown on every export. Image files and metadata are never sent to AI.
setting_ai_base_url_desc: OpenAI-compatible base URL; /chat/completions is added automatically
setting_ai_base_url_invalid: Enter a valid HTTP or HTTPS URL
setting_ai_secret_desc: Select a key in Obsidian SecretStorage; optional for local services
setting_ai_model_desc: Model name accepted by the configured endpoint
setting_ai_test_desc: Sends fixed test text only; no note content is included
setting_ai_privacy_desc: The complete final Markdown is sent to your configured provider. Images, image metadata, and the Obsidian source file are not sent. The plugin stores no review history; your provider's retention and billing policies still apply.
confirm_disable_ai_desc: Future exports will not send Markdown for review. Local image metadata cleaning will remain enabled.
review_stage_review: Reviewing the final Markdown with AI…
review_copy_only: Changes apply only to this export copy and never modify the Obsidian note.
metadata_failed_item: ⚠ {imageName}: cleaning failed; the original image will be exported
metadata_failure_confirm_title: Export an image that could contain private metadata?
metadata_failure_confirm_desc: At least one image could not be cleaned. Its original bytes may contain location, device, or capture details.
review_fix_error_target-not-unique: A selected fix does not uniquely match the final Markdown. Deselect it or cancel the export.
review_fix_error_empty-replacement: A selected replacement cannot be empty.
review_fix_error_overlapping-fixes: Selected fixes overlap. Deselect one of the conflicting fixes.
review_fix_error_invalid-frontmatter: The selected fixes would make the frontmatter invalid.
review_error_missing-config: Configure an API base URL and model, and select a stored key when the service requires one.
review_error_invalid-endpoint: The configured API base URL is invalid.
review_error_authentication: The AI provider rejected the API key.
review_error_insufficient-balance: The AI provider reports insufficient balance or quota.
review_error_rate-limit: The AI provider is rate-limiting requests. Try again later.
review_error_model: The configured endpoint or model was not found.
review_error_server: The AI provider is temporarily unavailable. Try again later.
review_error_timeout: The AI review timed out. The export has not been published.
review_error_invalid-response: The AI provider returned an invalid review response.
review_error_network: The AI provider request failed. The export has not been published.
